newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Makhteshim in deal with Bayer.
newsitem.headline: Makhteshim in deal with Bayer.

text.p: Israel's Makhteshim Chemical Works Ltd has signed a pact with Germany's Bayer AG giving Makhteshim exclusive rights to a Bayer agricultural herbicide, a source close to the deal said on Sunday.
Under the agreement, Makhteshim, a subsidiary of Koor Industries, will manufacture and market the German product, which the source would not identify.
"This will make Makhteshim almost the sole manufacturer in the world of this type of herbicide," said the source, adding that it would generate revenues of several million dollars a year.
Makhteshim's spokeswoman would neither confirm nor deny the deal.
The source source said the agreement had been reached some time ago but would not be formally announced.
The herbicide will be produced at Makhteshim's plant in Beersheba and sold under the Bayer brandname.
Makhteshim is the world's largest producer of generic agrochemical products with revenues of $416 million in the first nine months of 1996.
